baseline_scope: Equal weight and mandate-blind gamma3 are constructed diagnostic portfolios, not AI or human observations.
calendar_interpretation: Reference-month index only. Current revised source vintage does not establish prior-month public availability on historical month-start dates.

conditional_workload_if_legacy_four_stag.status: arithmetic only; no recent workflow runpack or AI execution created by this generator

memory_limitation: Historical data may overlap model pretraining. Inputs exclude future observations, but this is not proof of unseen data, no leakage, historical information-set reconstruction, or genuine future prediction.
model_exposure: Only model_visible payloads may be used; identifiers, reference months, reference answers, pair classifications and all evaluator_only fields remain evaluator metadata unless a separately reviewed prompt explicitly defines otherwise.

numerical_verification.precision_note: Imported float64 engineering checks: KKT factor 2048; SLSQP objective scale 100, ftol 1e-12, maxiter 1000. No effect-size threshold; not formal exact-arithmetic certification.

objective: U_gamma(w)=mu.T @ w-gamma/2*(w.T @ Sigma @ w); w>=0, sum(w)=1.
overlap: Adjacent windows share 59 of 60 months. These are 24 fixed overlapping scenarios, not 24 independent market samples or 72 observed institutions.
reference_interpretation: Conditional optimum for supplied estimated statistics; not true future returns, actual fund holdings, or realized profitability.
same_optimum_policy: Keep every case including shared optima; equality of recommended portfolios is not harmful convergence when the conditional optima coincide.
scope_ko: 최근 24개 기준월의 과거 60개월 통계에 대해 가상 기관의 명시된 수치 목적을 따르는지 확인하기 위한 보조 과제. 실제 월초 투자·문서해석·전략형성의 역사적 재현이 아니다.
selection_rule: All 24 months of 2024-2025 retained before AI execution; no selection by reference separation or model performance.

sources.engineering_tolerances: Float64/KKT tolerances, SLSQP convergence settings and response serialization tolerance are implementation choices, not paper-derived behavioral parameters.

french.adopted: Value-weighted monthly total returns for 12 industry baskets and date-matched monthly risk-free returns.
french.limits: Industry membership changes historically. Current revised CIZ vintage; not historical point-in-time releases or fixed constituent baskets.

portbench.adopted: 2024-2025 QA evaluation-year range as the calendar precedent, and long-only sum-one feasibility.
portbench.locators: Appendix B.2 QA test years 2024-2025; Appendix C.1 T5 long-only full-investment feasible set.
portbench.not_adopted: Its dynamic 2024 normal-period backtest, 60-trading-day lookback, max-Sharpe objective, constant annual 4% risk-free rate, or scoring weights.

sources.provenance: LIBERA_adaptation combining distinct paper conditions; not one published unified protocol.
sources.researcher_choices: 24 monthly reference tasks, no future evaluation, three fictional mandates, auxiliary-control role, deterministic numerical baselines.

salcher.adopted: Monthly decimal excess returns, 60-month sample moments, quadratic utility and gamma values.
salcher.locators: Section 3.2 Eq.(6), Tables 1-5 quadratic gamma=1,3,5; Section 4.1 60-month means/covariances.
salcher.not_adopted: 1964-2023 full period, future 36-month evaluation, unrestricted-short optimum, code-only covariance shrinkage.
